status: round-3 blocks: estimates with their world-clustered bootstrap intervals, and each comparison with the threshold of the design
units: fractions (x 100 for percent or pp); 95% world-clustered bootstrap, 2,000 draws, seed 996

notes.G1-G3: lower bound of the two-way interval > 0. G1 and G2 need both arms (D=1 and D_m) and all three draws (18 definitions); G3 is computed on the program sets given (at least 2; the cut order can leave fewer than 18) and says how many. The share between writers is the eta squared of the per-set B x D (and the one-way random-effects share); the S_del interaction per writer pools its sets (world bootstrap).
